presaleMint availability depends on block.timestamp within the presale window.

setStartingBlock records block.number when block.timestamp reaches REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.

mintedPumpkins is incremented after each presale mint.

_usedCoupons guards presaleMint against coupon replay.

normalization_plan.reason: The quantity parameter only exists to configure the mint loop bound and supply checks in mint.
The coupon string is consumed by the signature and replay checks of freeMint.
The signature blob is consumed by the free mint signature modifier.
The pass string is consumed by the signed presale mint path.
The recipient address only parameterizes the owner giveaway mint.
The token count only parameterizes the owner giveaway mint and pool limit.
The token id array is the sole input iterated by claim.
The upgrade token id array drives cost computation and level writes in upgradePumpkins.
The target level array is consumed by the upgrade cost and level storage logic.
The boolean only selects the claim branch inside upgradePumpkins.
The provenance string is only assigned by the one-time setter.
The local mintedSoFar value is a temporary derived from mintedPumpkins inside mint.
The local totalClaimQty aggregates emission amounts before the SEED mint in claim.
The local balance copy is only used to size the ether transfer in withdraw.
The local artId is a temporary shift of tokenId used only to build the URI.
